objective: uniform mean of ten local-client full-batch cross-entropies
training_split: all 89996 original training images; each uses its owner encoder
evaluation: uniform mean of all ten pipeline accuracies on the same complete 7180-image test
test_access: one predetermined before/after diagnostic; no tuning, checkpoint selection or threshold stop
simulation: ten spawned client processes; server receives only local loss and head gradient on optimizer channel
aggregation_precision: float32 mean in increasing client ID order
communication: count application bytes, opcodes and 4-byte Unix Pipe framing separately; exclude preinstalled model/data, OS process startup and disk archives
comparison: initial loss, centralized final loss, stored pre-last-step central gradient/loss, final objectives/gradients, train/test logits and same official test accuracy; no raw feature/label/logit transfer
